en.walletAccess: Sign in with your YNX Wallet to manage your channel and original media.
en.walletPending: Approve the request in your Wallet, then return here.
en.retryRequired: Unable to confirm the result. Check your connection and retry.
en.draftUnavailable: Your saved draft could not be opened. Its original files have been kept.
en.uploadInvalid: Check your channel, title, rights details and MP4 or WebM file.
en.uploadSaved: Your upload is saved. Complete the rights declaration and submit it for independent review.
en.uploadUnconfirmed: The upload result is unconfirmed. Check Content, then retry the saved upload.
en.cancelRetained: Draft cancelled. Local files and any saved server records are kept.
en.operationPending: A saved operation needs confirmation. Check the latest records before retrying or cancelling it.
en.cancelQuestion: Cancel the draft? Files and any completed server operation will be kept.
en.name: Channel name
en.title: Title
en.ownedConsent: I own this content or have documented permission to publish it.
en.uploadLimit: MP4 or WebM up to 511 MiB. A saved upload can be recovered after reconnecting.
en.noVideos: No videos yet. Create a channel, then upload your first video.
en.independentReview: Rights and publication require independent review before publishing.
en.payoutConsent: This creates a payout intent. Wallet confirmation and the final payment receipt are separate steps.
en.inviteHelp: Invite a named YNX account. Access begins only after they accept.
en.revokeQuestion: Revoke this team member? Their next restricted request will be denied.
en.disputeHelp: Submit a reason for human review. An appeal does not restore publication or confirm payment. Saved requests can be recovered from the latest records.
en.noReports: No reports on your accessible videos.
en.assetHelp: Preview a PNG, JPEG or WebP thumbnail (up to 5 MiB), or a UTF-8 WebVTT subtitle file (up to 1 MiB), then explicitly upload. Subtitles are marked as human approved. Saved uploads remain with their original account.
en.assetInvalid: Check the file format, size, subtitle language and label. A changed file must be previewed again.
en.assetUnconfirmed: Asset upload is unconfirmed. Check the latest records, then retry the saved upload.
en.assetSaved: Asset saved; original server bytes verified.
en.captionConsent: I have reviewed this subtitle file and approve it for this video.

zh-CN.walletAccess: 使用 YNX Wallet 登录，管理你的频道和原创媒体。
zh-CN.walletPending: 请在 Wallet 中确认请求，然后返回。
zh-CN.retryRequired: 暂时无法确认结果，请检查网络后重试。
zh-CN.draftUnavailable: 无法打开已保存的草稿，原文件已保留。
zh-CN.uploadInvalid: 请检查频道、标题、权利说明和 MP4 或 WebM 文件。
zh-CN.uploadSaved: 上传已保存，请完成权利声明并提交独立审核。
zh-CN.uploadUnconfirmed: 上传结果尚未确认，请先检查内容列表，再重试已保存的上传。
zh-CN.cancelRetained: 草稿已取消，本地文件和服务端已保存记录均保留。
zh-CN.operationPending: 有一项已保存操作需要确认，请检查最新记录后再重试或取消。
zh-CN.cancelQuestion: 取消草稿？原文件和已完成的服务端操作会保留。
zh-CN.name: 频道名称
zh-CN.title: 标题
zh-CN.ownedConsent: 我拥有此内容或有可证明的发布授权。
zh-CN.uploadLimit: 支持最大 511 MiB 的 MP4 或 WebM，重新连接后可以恢复已保存上传。
zh-CN.noVideos: 还没有视频，请先创建频道，再上传第一个视频。
zh-CN.independentReview: 权利和发布需要独立审核后才能公开。
zh-CN.noRevenue: 暂无经验证的收益记录。
zh-CN.payoutConsent: 此操作创建付款意向，Wallet 确认和最终付款回执是后续步骤。
zh-CN.uploadOwned: 上传自有或获授权媒体
zh-CN.inviteHelp: 邀请指定的 YNX 账号，对方接受后才会获得权限。
zh-CN.revokeQuestion: 撤销这位成员的权限？其下一次受限操作将被拒绝。
zh-CN.disputeHelp: 填写理由并提交人工审核。提交申诉不会自动恢复发布或确认付款。已保存的请求可结合最新记录恢复。
zh-CN.noReports: 你可访问的视频暂无举报记录。
zh-CN.assetHelp: 先预览 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 缩略图（最多 5 MiB），或 UTF-8 WebVTT 字幕（最多 1 MiB），再明确上传。字幕会标为人工确认。已保存的上传始终归属原账号。
zh-CN.retryAsset: 重试已保存的素材上传
zh-CN.assetInvalid: 请检查文件格式、大小、字幕语言和名称。文件内容变化后需要重新预览。
zh-CN.assetUnconfirmed: 素材上传结果未确认。请检查最新记录，再重试已保存的上传。
zh-CN.assetSaved: 素材已保存，原服务文件字节已核对。
zh-CN.captionConsent: 我已审核此字幕文件，并确认用于这个视频。
